title: BidIt
summary: A real-time auction platform with live bidding through a Flutter mobile app, powered by Laravel backend with WebSocket broadcasting.

images.alt: Admin dashboard and bid audit trail
images.caption: Admin dashboard

problem: Traditional auction platforms rely on periodic polling, causing delayed bid updates and missed opportunities during final auction seconds.
outcome: Scalable real-time auction platform with instant bid sync, automated product listing, and comprehensive auction management.
outcomeHighlight: Sub-second real-time bidding powered by WebSockets.

title: TopCars
summary: A multi-language automotive marketplace for browsing, buying, selling, and renting vehicles through Flutter and Laravel.
problem: Regional automotive marketplaces lack localization, offer outdated interfaces, and fragment buying/selling/renting into separate platforms.
outcome: Modern automotive marketplace consolidating buying, selling, and renting into a single localized platform.
outcomeHighlight: Unified marketplace for buying, selling, and renting vehicles.

title: MediaNexus
summary: A native iOS entertainment app delivering a cinematic movie and TV discovery experience using SwiftUI, Combine, and TMDb API.
problem: Media discovery apps suffer from slow loading, fragmented content, and uninspiring interfaces with sequential network requests.
outcome: High-performance native iOS app combining fast concurrent networking with a polished cinematic interface.
outcomeHighlight: Parallel multi-endpoint loading for seamless cinematic browsing.

title: SPORTSTREAM
summary: A lightweight sports streaming hub for Smart TVs, desktops, and mobile, with a cinematic interface and spatial remote navigation.
problem: Sports fans rely on multiple fragmented websites with intrusive ads and poor Smart TV usability for live match streaming.
outcome: Fast, responsive sports streaming hub with modern viewing experience across desktops and Smart TVs.
outcomeHighlight: Framework-free sports streaming platform optimized for Smart TVs.

title: Transcanada Export
summary: End-to-end car export ecosystem — web platform, mobile tracking app, and real-time admin portal.
problem: Vehicle export logistics were fragmented across spreadsheets, manual WhatsApp updates, and paper docs, causing tracking delays.
outcome: Reduced vehicle processing time by 65% and onboarded over 10,000 active buyers within 3 months.
features: Admin panel for car & customer management

title: Eye Tracking Mouse Controller
summary: A desktop app that transforms eye movements into mouse cursor control using computer vision, enabling hands-free interaction through a webcam.
problem: Traditional cursor interaction depends on physical input devices, making hands-free control difficult for accessibility needs.
outcome: Functional proof-of-concept controlling the system mouse cursor through eye movement alone with calibration and smoothing.
outcomeHighlight: Hands-free mouse control using only a webcam.

title: eID & Passport Scanner
summary: Scans passports and eID cards, validates MRZ data, and reads biometric information from NFC chips using the ICAO 9303 standard.

images.alt: eID scanner home and scan flow
images.caption: Scan flow

problem: Identity verification requires manually entering document info before reading NFC chips, making the process slow and error-prone.
outcome: Secure identity verification app for scanning MRZ data, validating integrity, and reading biometrics from ICAO-compliant documents.
outcomeHighlight: End-to-end MRZ scanning and secure NFC biometric verification.

title: SmartRetail
summary: All-in-one retail management system for small businesses with POS, inventory, and revenue reporting.
problem: Small businesses lack affordable, comprehensive retail management tools that combine POS, inventory, and financial tracking.
outcome: Comprehensive desktop retail solution handling POS, inventory, debt tracking, and revenue analytics for small businesses.
outcomeHighlight: All-in-one retail management for small businesses.

title: mrtravel App
summary: Personalized trip planning application with real-time updates and travel recommendations.
problem: Trip planning involves juggling multiple apps and websites, creating a fragmented travel experience.
outcome: Seamless cross-platform trip planning app with personalized recommendations and real-time travel updates.
outcomeHighlight: Personalized trip planning with real-time updates.

title: AR Wayfinding
summary: Next-gen indoor navigation using Augmented Reality markers and pathfinding algorithms.
problem: Indoor navigation systems rely on imprecise GPS or static signage, providing poor real-time guidance in complex buildings.
outcome: Immersive AR-based indoor navigation system with real-time pathfinding and marker-based positioning.
outcomeHighlight: AR-powered indoor navigation with real-time pathfinding.

title: Real-time Chat
summary: Instant messaging app with seamless real-time synchronization powered by Firebase.
problem: Many chat apps sacrifice simplicity for feature bloat, creating overly complex interfaces for basic messaging needs.
outcome: Clean, responsive messaging application with real-time sync and modern UI powered by Firebase.
